comment: ANCHOR: WATCH_LISTS_20261023 — Watch IA (operator 2026-10-23): My Watchlist = every operator name (stars, personal
watchlist, operator ticker directives, operator adds; watch_domains.membership_operator), starred first, never capped,
never expired (expiry only suggests); Prospects lists every operator name; System Suggests = top N (20, max 30) of the
same curator ranking as Full universe minus held/yours/dismissed, focus-list hysteresis with entry/exit reasons from
rank_history; Full universe on Watch overlays held/formerly held/never held from the Watch held reader, the last round
trip and re-entry advice (CIO prospect lifecycle) — a sold name is Re-entry/formerly held, never Add-On/ADD; position
filters/sorts server-side with stated rules; suggest dismiss is an audited watchlist_events row with the cc_auth
principal; the curator's held flag reads positions_current only once reader batch #4 is granted (fail closed).
